description: Muse + Krea 2 General Edit V2 LoRA (conradlocke, personal/non-commercial licence) via comfyui-krea2edit nodes: edit an uploaded photo by a plain instruction, no mask. The whole picture is re-rendered (very close to the photo); muse-inpaint keeps the pixels outside the mask exactly
timing: 1184x888 10 steps: 57-62 s warm, 88 s with the LoRA load

image.note: uploaded photo; the output keeps its layout

prompt.note: plain instruction: "Add a ginger cat sleeping on the bed", "Remove the white pillow", "Make it night"

steps.note: LoRA author: 8 for Turbo; 16 steps + CFG 2 also removed the pillow when adding the cat

cfg.note: author: 1 for most edits, 3 (20 steps) for big removals; the negative is already grounded on the photo

width.note: output size = photo size (multiple of 16, at most ~2 MP)

refBoost.note: pull toward the source photo; author: 4 for General Edit

groundingPx.note: longest side of the photo shown to Qwen3-VL (trained at 768)
